slide.text: The platform can be procured and deployed in phases, beginning with high-friction land and approval workflows and expanding into wider public-delivery and market-trust use cases.

p.strong: State land-administration and C of O pilot

slide.text: Start with Certificate of Occupancy, land-rights continuity, queues, field evidence, and supervisory reporting.
Add planning, environment, infrastructure, and sector-specific approvals on the same accountable workflow backbone.

p.strong: Revenue assurance and external trust layer

slide.text: Expand audit verification, public-key trust, external validation, and revenue-oriented reporting for state and federal leadership.
Extend into mining, oil and gas, wider public approvals, and cross-jurisdiction scaling once the core state model is proven.

text.p: The platform already demonstrates portable deployment, real workflow screens, role-based governance, low-connectivity field continuity, signed audit controls, and cross-surface delivery across web and native mobile.
That means procurement can focus on rollout choice, hosting model, agency adoption, and service-level expectations instead of starting from a blank technical concept.

p.strong: The strongest first procurement case is state land administration and Certificate of Occupancy modernization with revenue-assurance visibility built in from day one.

slide.text: Nigeria-first rollout creates the strongest proof point for wider federal, sector, and African scale.
